issues.failure_explanation: The decomposition defines $\Delta_3$ with kernel time $t-s$. The Fubini identity makes the first term of $\Delta_5$ equal to $b(s,X_{\tau_s^h}^h)\cdot\nabla_y p_\alpha(t-s,y-X_{\tau_s^h}^h)$, which cancels the second term of $\Delta_3$; the first term of $\Delta_3$ cancels with the second term of $\Delta_2$. Hence $\Delta_3$ is not left for Gronwall and disappears from the sum. The later remaining Gronwall term uses kernel time $t-\tau_s^h$, which is not obtained from the stated decomposition and would require additional time-change terms that are never introduced or estimated.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Rework the error decomposition so that the term intended for the Gronwall argument is correctly separated, adding and estimating the missing time-change terms between kernels at times $t-s$ and $t-\tau_s^h$ for both $X_{\tau_s^h}$ and $X_{\tau_s^h}^h$.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the main convergence-rate theorem is invalid as written; the stated bound in Theorem \ref{thm-main} is not established by the given argument.
issues.title: Error decomposition in main theorem proof leaves an underived Gronwall term
issues.why_classification: The defect occurs in the central proof of the paper's main theorem and requires a nontrivial repair of the error decomposition; the existing proof does not establish the main result.
